content: Official ACP SDKs from zed-industries/agent-client-protocol: TypeScript (@agentclientprotocol/sdk npm), Rust (crates.io agent-client-protocol + agent-client-protocol-schema), Python, Kotlin, Java. NO official Go SDK. Stable protocol version = 1; schemas versioned via schema-v* GitHub releases (schema/v1, v2 dirs). Community libs listed on agentclientprotocol.com/libraries/community.
